scripts.render-build: pnpm lint || echo '[render-build] lint reported issues (non-blocking for deploy; fix via CI/pre-commit)'; pnpm --filter @trading-app/shared build && pnpm --filter @trading-app/engine build && pnpm --filter @trading-app/backtest build && pnpm --filter @trading-app/server build && pnpm --filter desktop vite:build
scripts.pretest: node scripts/check-stale-js.mjs && pnpm --filter @trading-app/shared build && pnpm --filter @trading-app/engine build && pnpm --filter @trading-app/backtest build

pnpm.//: TRA-1052 — .npmrc sets approve-builds=false, so pnpm skips dependency install/build scripts unless allowlisted here. better-sqlite3 is a native module that relies on prebuild-install (an install script) to fetch its prebuilt binary; WITHOUT this entry the binary is silently absent and the server crashes on require. Listed explicitly so `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` on Render fetches the prebuilt .node (no compilation, so no render-build OOM regression — TRA-1037/1038).
